Server image from a clean worktree at a6c130ae (server code identical to 63a4f8ac); 'dirty' is another session's uncommitted files on the host. Host load average 11-12 from unrelated apps: absolute timings are loaded-machine numbers. 1043 passed; 117 benches ok, 60 skipped (spaces on other volumes), 1 KNOWN HOLE: query.covering.advantage_growth failed its visibility-map guard inside the full core suite (2/2; passes standalone 3/3) - see issues/345.
